When `round(duration * fps)` evaluates to `0` (e.g., for extremely short or truncated video clips), `total_frames` is set to `0`. This can lead to unhandled division-by-zero or empty sequence exceptions in downstream frame sampling logic, crashing the inference request.

This prevents downstream division-by-zero or empty-sequence errors for extremely short or truncated video clips.
